.rcx .footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;margin-top:20px;padding:15px 22px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--color-background-info);border:1px solid var(--color-border-info)}

# Opinion vs. Research

---
### The Difference Between Opinion and Research

.pull-left[
.content-box-yellow[
### `r fontawesome::fa("comment", height = "1em")` Opinion

What you think or feel about something, based on personal perspective.

- **Subjective**
- Based on personal belief
- May lack supporting evidence
]
]

.pull-right[
.content-box-blue[
### `r fontawesome::fa("flask", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Research

Systematic investigation that produces evidence-based conclusions.

- **Objective**
- Based on data and evidence
- Follows methodical processes
]
]

---
### Examples of Opinion

.font110[
- `r fontawesome::fa("comment", fill = "#FFC520")` Everyone should stop using social media completely.

- `r fontawesome::fa("comment", fill = "#FFC520")` It's better to study late at night than early in the morning.

- `r fontawesome::fa("comment", fill = "#FFC520")` Recycling doesn't make much of a difference to the planet.

- `r fontawesome::fa("comment", fill = "#FFC520")` Fast food should be banned in school cafeterias.

- `r fontawesome::fa("comment", fill = "#FFC520")` Climate change is too big of a problem for individuals to make a difference.
]

---
### Examples of Research Statements

.font80[
- `r fontawesome::fa("flask", fill = "#4a7fb5")` According to the **CDC's 2021 Youth Risk Behavior Survey**, which surveyed over 14,000 U.S. high school students, nearly **30% reported feeling persistently sad or hopeless** during the past year.

- `r fontawesome::fa("flask", fill = "#4a7fb5")` A 2020 global survey by **Pew Research Center** involving more than 13,000 adults in 13 countries found that 73% saw climate change as a major threat to their country.

- `r fontawesome::fa("flask", fill = "#4a7fb5")` A **randomized controlled sleep study at UC Berkeley** found that **teens who slept at least 8 hours** performed significantly better on memory tasks than those with less sleep. The study involved **105 adolescents aged 13&ndash;17**. *(Lopez et al., Sleep Research Journal, 2018)*

- `r fontawesome::fa("flask", fill = "#4a7fb5")` The **World Health Organization**, based on data from dozens of national health agencies, estimates that **air pollution causes 7 million premature deaths worldwide each year**. *(WHO, 2021)*

- `r fontawesome::fa("flask", fill = "#4a7fb5")` In a **Common Sense Media survey** of 1,306 teens aged 13&ndash;17, 25% reported that social media had a mostly negative impact on their mental health. *(Common Sense Media, 2021)*
]

### What is Research?

.three-col[
.col[
`r fontawesome::fa("compass", height = "2.5em", fill = "#4a7fb5")`

**A Journey of Discovery**

Research is a systematic investigation to establish facts and reach new conclusions.
]
.col[
`r fontawesome::fa("circle-question", height = "2.5em", fill = "#4a7fb5")`

**Question-Driven**

Every great discovery begins with a well-framed question that guides your direction.
]
.col[
`r fontawesome::fa("lightbulb", height = "2.5em", fill = "#4a7fb5")`

**Evidence-Based**

Research relies on gathering and analyzing evidence rather than opinions or assumptions.
]
]

class: center, middle

<br>

## Sports Analytics: Do Home Teams Really Win More?

.font130[**Do home teams have a real advantage in the NBA &mdash; and if so, _why_?**]

--

.three-col[
.col[
.content-box-blue[
**The Fan's Opinion**

"Of course they do! The home crowd fires up the players and rattles the visitors."
]
]
.col[
.content-box-blue[
**An Analyst's Hypothesis**

Maybe it isn't the crowd at all &mdash; it could be travel fatigue, familiar rims, or favorable refereeing.
]
]
.col[
.content-box-blue[
**A Research Approach**

Pull every NBA game from basketball-reference.com, compare home vs. away win rates, then test _which_ story the evidence supports.
]
]
]

---
## What the NBA Data Shows

.pull-left[
```{r nba-home, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE, out.width="100%", out.height="430px", fig.width=8, fig.height=6, fig.show='hold', fig.align='center'}
# Real NBA regular-season home win % (basketball-reference.com / NBA.com)
nba_home <- tibble::tribble(
  ~season,        ~home_win_pct,
  "2000–13 avg",  60,
  "2014–19 avg",  58,
  "2020–21",      54,
  "2022–23",      58,
  "2023–25 avg",  54
)
nba_home$season <- factor(nba_home$season, levels = nba_home$season)

ggplot(nba_home, aes(x = season, y = home_win_pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0148A4", width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#D55E00", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(home_win_pct, "%")), vjust = -0.6, size = 6,
            family = "firasans") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 51.5, label = "50% = no advantage",
           hjust = 0, colour = "#D55E00", size = 5, family = "firasans") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 68)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Home team win %",
       title = "Home teams win more than half their games") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13))
```
]

.pull-right[
.font110[Across two decades, NBA home teams have won **well above 50%** of regular-season games &mdash; but the edge has **shrunk over time**.]

#### `r fontawesome::fa("trophy", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` &nbsp; ~60% home wins in 2000&ndash;2013

#### `r fontawesome::fa("arrow-trend-down", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` &nbsp; Down to ~54% in recent seasons

#### `r fontawesome::fa("user-slash", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` &nbsp; Lowest (54%) in 2020&ndash;21 &mdash; **empty arenas**
]

---
## So... is this a research question?

.three-col[
.col[
`r fontawesome::fa("circle-question", height = "2.5em", fill = "#4a7fb5")`

**Is this a research question?**

"Home teams win more" is a _fact_. "_Why_ do they win more?" is the research question.
]
.col[
`r fontawesome::fa("magnifying-glass-chart", height = "2.5em", fill = "#4a7fb5")`

**What evidence would we need?**

Crowd size, travel distance, rest days, referee calls &mdash; data that can separate the competing explanations.
]
.col[
`r fontawesome::fa("scale-balanced", height = "2.5em", fill = "#4a7fb5")`

**What would 'prove' it?**

We don't "prove" &mdash; we build evidence. The **empty-arena 2020&ndash;21 season** acts like a natural experiment on the crowd effect.
]
]

---
### From Curiosity to Focused Questions

.three-col[
.col[
`r fontawesome::fa("bolt", height = "2.5em", fill = "#4a7fb5")`

**Curiosity Spark**

The urge to know more about something that intrigues you.
]
.col[
`r fontawesome::fa("cloud", height = "2.5em", fill = "#4a7fb5")`

**Wonder**

Asking yourself "Why is this happening?" or "How does this work?"
]
.col[
`r fontawesome::fa("magnifying-glass", height = "2.5em", fill = "#4a7fb5")`

**Research Question**

Transforming curiosity into a clear, specific question to explore.
]
]

--

.content-box-blue[**"What's that claim based on?"**]
]

.pull-right[
.content-box-blue[**"Has anyone actually tested it?"**]

.content-box-blue[**"Where is the evidence?"**]
]

## Scenario 1: The Medical Trial

.font90[Dr. Lopez wants to know if a new blood pressure medication, **CardioPure**, is more effective than the current standard treatment. She tracks **200 patients** for six months. Half receive the standard drug, the other half receive CardioPure. At the end, she records the average drop in systolic blood pressure: the standard group dropped **8 mmHg**, while the CardioPure group dropped **14 mmHg** with no major side effects.]

]
]

## Scenario 2: Urban Planning

.font90[The **City of Springfield** wants to increase bike commuting and reduce traffic congestion, but only has budget to build **one** new protected bike lane. They consider two streets: **Oak Street** and **Maple Avenue**. For two weeks, electronic sensors count cyclists currently using both streets, and an online survey asks **1,000 residents** which route they prefer. The data: Maple Avenue has **300% more** daily cyclists than Oak Street, and **75%** of residents prefer Maple Avenue. The council votes to build the lane on Maple Avenue.]

.three-col[
.col[
.content-box-blue[
**Research Question:**

]

]
]
]

## Scenario 3: Tech & E-Commerce

.font90[A popular clothing app, **TrendThread**, wants to see if changing their "Buy Now" button from blue to bright green will increase purchases. They run an **A/B test** for one week. Half of users randomly see the original blue button (**Group A**), the other half see the new green button (**Group B**). Analytics track clicks and completed checkouts. **Group A** had a **2.1%** checkout rate, while **Group B** had a **3.5%** checkout rate. The company permanently switches the button to green.]

.three-col[

.content-box-blue[

]
]

## Scenario 4: Education & Teaching

.font90[**Mr. Harrison** wants to know whether interactive digital educational games help his 9th-grade algebra students understand quadratic equations better than traditional textbook worksheets. His **morning class** is taught using only the digital app; his **afternoon class** uses standard textbook worksheets. After two weeks, both classes take the **exact same** unit exam. The morning class (digital app) scores an average of **84%**, while the afternoon class (textbook) scores **76%**. Mr. Harrison decides to use the digital app in all his algebra classes next semester.]

## Scenario 5: Public Health Tracking

.font80[During a seasonal outbreak of a new COVID-19 variant, county health officials want to determine if the virus spreads faster in **indoor dining spaces** compared to **outdoor public areas**. They track positive case reports over a month, interviewing **500 infected residents** about recent locations, and collect **wastewater samples** to measure viral load. The interviews reveal **82%** of infected individuals had visited crowded indoor restaurants, compared to only **12%** who attended outdoor-only events. Wastewater data confirms massive spikes in areas dense with indoor venues. The government issues a temporary indoor mask advisory for restaurants.]

### `r fontawesome::fa("temperature-high", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Climate Change

.pull-left[
#### What it's about:
.font90[The planet you'll spend your whole life on is heating up. Burning fossil fuels traps heat, fueling the record heat waves, wildfire-smoke days, and flooding many of you have already lived through.]
]

.pull-right[
#### Key Facts:
.font80[
- The global average temperature has already increased by **1.1&deg;C (2&deg;F)** since the late 1800s *(NASA, 2024)*.

- **2023 was the hottest year on record**, with ocean temperatures hitting record highs *(Copernicus Climate Change Service, 2024)*.

- Nearly **6 in 10 young people (ages 16&ndash;25)** say they are very or extremely worried about climate change *(Lancet, 2021)*.
]
]

---
### `r fontawesome::fa("solar-panel", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Renewable Energy

.pull-left[
#### What it's about:
.font90[The switch from fossil fuels to clean energy&mdash;solar, wind, hydro&mdash;is already showing up in your life: the EVs on your street, solar panels on rooftops, and how your future home and phone get powered.]
]

.pull-right[
#### Key Facts:
.font80[
- In 2023, **30% of global electricity** came from renewable sources *(IEA)*.

- Solar power is now **cheaper than coal** in many countries *(BloombergNEF, 2023)*.

- **Nearly 1 in 5 new cars** sold worldwide in 2023 was electric&mdash;up from almost none a decade ago *(IEA, 2024)*.
]
]

---
### `r fontawesome::fa("virus", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Public Health Pandemics

.pull-left[
#### What it's about:
.font90[You lived through one. COVID-19 closed schools, moved class to a screen, and canceled sports, concerts, and graduations&mdash;showing how fast a virus can upend everyday life.]
]

.pull-right[
#### Key Facts:
.font80[
- COVID-19 led to over **770 million confirmed cases** globally by 2024 *(WHO)*.

- Global vaccine distribution exposed **serious inequalities**: only 26% of people in low-income countries received at least one vaccine dose by late 2022 *(Our World in Data)*.

- At the peak in 2020, schools closed for **about 1.6 billion students** across **190+ countries**&mdash;likely including yours *(UNESCO, 2020)*.
]
]

---
### `r fontawesome::fa("scale-unbalanced", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Poverty and Inequality

.pull-left[
#### What it's about:
.font90[Two students with the same talent can face completely different futures based on family income&mdash;shaping whether they can afford a laptop, internet, tutoring, or college.]
]

.pull-right[
#### Key Facts:
.font80[
- Over **700 million people**&mdash;about 1 in 11 globally&mdash;live on **less than $2.15 a day** *(World Bank, 2024)*.

- The **richest 1%** of the world's population owns almost **half of all global wealth** *(Oxfam, 2023)*.

- About **2.6 billion people are still offline**, making online schoolwork and opportunities far harder to reach *(ITU, 2023)*.
]
]

---
### `r fontawesome::fa("graduation-cap", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Educational Access

.pull-left[
#### What it's about:
.font90[Imagine not being able to finish high school. For millions of teens, school isn't a given&mdash;it's blocked by cost, conflict, or simply being a girl.]
]

.pull-right[
#### Key Facts:
.font80[
- **244 million children and youth** are out of school worldwide *(UNESCO, 2023)*.

- Girls are **more likely to be excluded** from school in low-income countries, especially during crises like war or pandemics.

- About **160 million children**&mdash;many of them teens&mdash;are in child labor instead of school *(ILO &amp; UNICEF, 2021)*.
]
]

---
### `r fontawesome::fa("user-shield", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Digital Privacy

.pull-left[
#### What it's about:
.font90[Every app you scroll&mdash;TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat&mdash;collects data about you: what you watch, where you go, and who you talk to. Who owns that data, and how it's used, is a growing fight.]
]

.pull-right[
#### Key Facts:
.font80[
- US teens spend an average of **4.8 hours a day** on social media&mdash;nearly **6 hours** for 17-year-olds&mdash;every minute feeding data to apps *(Gallup, 2023)*.

- In 2023, **over 7 billion data records** were exposed in breaches *(IT Governance, 2024)*.

- Over **60% of teens don't understand** how their online data is collected, shared, or used *(Harvard Kennedy School, 2023)*.
]
]

---
### `r fontawesome::fa("brain", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Mental Health

.pull-left[
#### What it's about:
.font90[The pressure you feel&mdash;school, grades, social media, the future&mdash;is part of a real and growing crisis in how young people are doing emotionally.]
]

.pull-right[
#### Key Facts:
.font80[
- Globally, about **1 in 7 teens (ages 10&ndash;19)** lives with a mental health disorder *(WHO, 2024)*.

- In 2023, **about 40% of US high school students** felt persistently sad or hopeless *(CDC, 2023)*.

- Suicide is one of the **leading causes of death** for people aged 15&ndash;29 worldwide *(WHO, 2024)*.
]
]

---
### `r fontawesome::fa("robot", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Artificial Intelligence

.pull-left[
#### What it's about:
.font90[From the feeds that pick your videos to chatbots that write essays, AI is reshaping how you learn, create, and&mdash;eventually&mdash;work. It also raises big questions about fairness and truth.]
]

.pull-right[
#### Key Facts:
.font80[
- **ChatGPT reached 100 million users in about 2 months**&mdash;the fastest-growing consumer app at the time *(UBS / Reuters, 2023)*.

- **About 1 in 4 US teens** have used ChatGPT for schoolwork&mdash;**double** the share a year earlier *(Pew Research, 2025)*.

- The IMF estimates **~40% of jobs worldwide** are exposed to AI, reshaping the careers you're heading into *(IMF, 2024)*.
]
]

---
### `r fontawesome::fa("circle-exclamation", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Misinformation

.pull-left[
#### What it's about:
.font90[Half of what you scroll past could be misleading. Telling real news from rumors, ads, and AI-generated fakes is becoming a basic survival skill online.]
]

.pull-right[
#### Key Facts:
.font80[
- On social media, **false news spreads about 6&times; faster** than the truth *(MIT, Science, 2018)*.

- Falsehoods are **70% more likely to be shared** than true stories *(MIT, Science, 2018)*.

- The World Economic Forum ranked **misinformation the #1 short-term global risk** for 2024, driven largely by AI *(WEF, 2024)*.
]
]

---
### `r fontawesome::fa("droplet", height = "1em", fill = "#4a7fb5")` Clean Water & Sanitation

.pull-left[
#### What it's about:
.font90[You turn on a tap without thinking&mdash;but billions of people can't. Access to safe water and a working toilet still shapes health, school, and daily life around the world.]
]

.pull-right[
#### Key Facts:
.font80[
- **2.2 billion people** still lack safely managed drinking water *(WHO/UNICEF, 2023)*.

- **3.5 billion people** lack safely managed sanitation, like a safe toilet *(WHO/UNICEF, 2023)*.

- In homes without water on tap, **women and girls** do most of the water-collecting&mdash;time that could be spent in school *(WHO/UNICEF, 2023)*.
]
]
